description: This file contains implementation of functions related to processing TCP socket data for the ANSC Daemon Server component. It includes functions for querying process mode, processing data synchronously and asynchronously, and initiating worker tasks for handling incoming data, specifically within the context of a TCP server daemon in an advanced networking container environment.

methods.name: ULONG AnscDstoQuery(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hSocket,PVOID buffer,ULONG ulSize,PANSC_HANDLE phQueryContext)
methods.description: Determines the process mode for incoming socket data by querying the worker object.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS AnscDstoProcessSync(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hSocket,PVOID buffer,ULONG ulSize,ANSC_HANDLE hQueryContext)
methods.description: Processes incoming TCP data synchronously via the worker object.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS AnscDstoProcessAsync(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hSocket,PVOID buffer,ULONG ulSize,ANSC_HANDLE hQueryContext)
methods.description: Initiates asynchronous processing of TCP data by disabling reception, spawning a worker task for processing.
